aboutMe.headline: About me
aboutMe.introText: Hi, I'm a german speaking Frontend Developer based in Dortmund. Motivated by the limitless opportunities within IT, I am excited about crafting visually captivating and intuitive websites and applications.
aboutMe.bulletpoint1: Flexible in terms of working environments, I can work effectively both on-site in Dortmund and remotely.
aboutMe.bulletpoint2: I am open-minded and always looking for personal challenges to constantly improve my knowledge and skills.
aboutMe.bulletpoint3: In my profession, programming isn't just about writing code; it's a creative form of problem-solving. I take pride in my ability to distill complex technical challenges into simple, user-friendly solutions. This way, I help you achieve your goals and bring your visions to life.

skills.headline: Skill set
skills.introText: My journey has involved working on diverse projects, employing a range of frontend technologies and concepts. I am open to embracing new technologies and methodologies to Continously enhance my skills and stay ahead in the ever-evolving landscape of web development.
skills.subText: Feel free to contact me. I look forward to expanding on my previous knowledge.

featuredProjects.headline: Featured Projects
featuredProjects.introText: Explore a selection of my work here - Interact with projects to see my skills in action.

projectDetails.headline: What is this project about?
projectDetails.descriptionJoin: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assing users and categories.
projectDetails.descriptionMana: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help the mage find scrolls to summon and defeat a strong foe.
projectDetails.descriptionPoke: A website serving as a Pokédex app was developed using JavaScript and utilizes the RESTful PokéAPI to dynamically fetch Pokémon data such as names, types, and abilities.
projectDetails.descriptionPort: A portfolio website showcasing my skills and projects in web development. With a clean structure and appealing design, it highlights my expertise in technologies like Angular, TypeScript and SCSS.

contact.headline: Let's work together
contact.subText: Contact me through this form, I am interested in hearing from you, knowing your ideas and contributing to your projects with my work. Need a Frontend developer? Let's talk!
